views.name: social_report_source_authority
views.definition:
SELECT b.id AS record_id,
    j.id AS ingestion_id,
    encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(to_jsonb(b.*) - 'provenance'::text - 'created_at'::text - 'updated_at'::text, lineage.entry, to_jsonb(e.*), to_jsonb(p.*), to_jsonb(d.*), jsonb_build_array(j.id, j.domain, j.status, j.dry_run, j.started_at, j.finished_at, j.errors, j.metadata ->> 'source_mode'::text), dated.item, receipts.items, cohort.items)::text, 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text) AS authority_fingerprint
   FROM budget_lines b
     JOIN entities e ON e.id = b.entity_id
     JOIN fiscal_periods p ON p.id = b.period_id
     JOIN source_documents d ON d.id = b.source_document_id
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.provenance) = 'array'::text THEN b.provenance
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END) lineage(entry)
     JOIN ingestion_jobs j ON j.id::text = (lineage.entry ->> 'ingestion_job_id'::text)
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT to_jsonb(locked_date.*) AS item
           FROM ( SELECT x.id,
                    x.source_document_id,
                    x.page_number,
                    x.extracted_json,
                    x.extractor,
                    x.confidence,
                    x.created_at
                   FROM extractions x
                  WHERE x.id::text = ((d.metadata -> 'publication_date_evidence'::text) ->> 'extraction_id'::text)
                 FOR SHARE OF x) locked_date) dated ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x.*) ORDER BY x.id) AS items
           FROM ( SELECT x_1.id,
                    x_1.source_document_id,
                    x_1.page_number,
                    x_1.extracted_json,
                    x_1.extractor,
                    x_1.confidence,
                    x_1.created_at
                   FROM extractions x_1
                  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                                CASE
                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(lineage.entry -> 'source_evidence'::text) = 'array'::text THEN lineage.entry -> 'source_evidence'::text
                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                                END) evidence(value)
                          WHERE x_1.id::text = ((evidence.value -> 'receipt'::text) ->> 'extraction_id'::text)))
                 FOR SHARE OF x_1) x) receipts ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(c.id, c.source_document_id, c.period_id) ORDER BY c.id) AS items
           FROM ( SELECT c_1.id,
                    c_1.entity_id,
                    c_1.period_id,
                    c_1.category,
                    c_1.subcategory,
                    c_1.allocated_amount,
                    c_1.actual_spent,
                    c_1.committed_amount,
                    c_1.currency,
                    c_1.source_document_id,
                    c_1.page_ref,
                    c_1.notes,
                    c_1.provenance,
                    c_1.source_hash,
                    c_1.created_at,
                    c_1.line_type,
                    c_1.extraction_id,
                    c_1.confidence_score,
                    c_1.basis,
                    c_1.publishable,
                    c_1.quarantine_reason
                   FROM budget_lines c_1
                  WHERE c_1.entity_id = b.entity_id AND c_1.provenance @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('ingestion_job_id', j.id))
                 FOR SHARE OF c_1) c) cohort ON true
 FOR SHARE OF b
 FOR SHARE OF p
 FOR SHARE OF d
 FOR SHARE OF j
 FOR UPDATE OF e;
